author: Sage
name: Sage game client half
description: A client half (a HUD, screens: what needs a screen) for a Sage game that has none, such as a sage-game-data game: a project in the game's Client/ folder that builds the game's own project too, and whose dotnet run starts the game. game.json loads it through "modules": { "add": ["Client/bin/{config}/MyGame.Client.dll"] }; sage new game-client --game <game folder> makes it there and adds that.

sdkVersion.description: The Sage.Sdk version the project names (Sage.Sdk/version in its Sdk attribute). The pack sets the default to the version packed (build/Sage.Version.props, from git tags); pass it when installing the template straight from its folder.

gameDir.description: The game folder (the one with game.json), relative to the new project's folder. The default is for the game's Client/ folder.
